question: 各年龄段用户销售额怎么样
gold_sql:
select case
  when u.age between 18 and 25 then '18-25岁'
  when u.age between 26 and 35 then '26-35岁'
  when u.age between 36 and 45 then '36-45岁'
  when u.age between 46 and 60 then '46-60岁'
  else '60岁以上'
end as age_bucket, sum(o.total_amount) as total_sales
from orders o left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id
where o.status = '已完成'
group by age_bucket
order by age_bucket
raw_output:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁'
        WHEN u.age BETWEEN 46 AND 60 THEN '46-60岁'
        WHEN u.age >= 61 THEN '60岁以上'
    END AS age_group,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS sales
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_group
        WHEN '18-25岁' THEN 1
        WHEN '26-35岁' THEN 2
        WHEN '36-45岁' THEN 3
        WHEN '46-60岁' THEN 4
        WHEN '60岁以上' THEN 5
    END;
